newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nat Aust Bnk raises St George stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nat Aust Bnk raises St George stake.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Thursday it had increased its stake in New South Wales-based regional bank, St George Bank Ltd, to 7.79 percent from 6.79 percent.
In a substantial shareholder notice lodged with the Australian Stock Exchange, NAB said its holding had increased to 16.21 million shares from 14.12 million.
St George Bank is currently in the process of merging with fellow New South Wales-based regional bank, Advance Bank Ltd.
The terms of the merger see St George offering cash and scrip that values Advance Bank shares at A$7.30 each.
